title: Transmuter's Stone (Fire)
summary: Resistance to Fire damage while carried.

fields.Effect: Resistance to Fire damage while carried. You can pass the stone to another party member.
fields.Creation: Level 6 Transmutation Wizard free action. Normally one stone per creator. A Long Rest or casting a level 1+ Transmutation spell refreshes creation. Ritual casting also works.
fields.Persistence: Persists until the creator makes another stone, leaves the party or changes class. Stones from different casters can coexist.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
